content: Austin Griffith (austingriffith.com, BuidlGuidl founder) portfolio structured as a project index (BuidlGuidl, SpeedRunEthereum, scaffold-eth, eth.build, punkwallet.io) each linking to a live, usable tool -- proof-of-work-as-product rather than screenshots. Reinforces that top web3 engineers ship things visitors can actually use, not just read about.
